coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete the audit for PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an inconclusive package verdict.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) during file audits to prevent a single failed request from invalidating the entire package review.
If a file was already successfully audited during the initial PKGBUILD safety gate, the tool should retain that verdict rather than failing the full review if the subsequent API call errors out.
